رتَلٌ inf. n. of 1: (Msb:) [Evenness in the growth of the front teeth: or their being separate, one from another, and even in the manner of growth, and well set together: (see 1 and رَتِلٌ:) or] whiteness, [or much whiteness,] and much lustre, of the teeth. (M, K.) ―
-b2- And A good, (M, K, TA,) and correct, or right, (TA,) state of arrangement or disposition of a thing. (M, K, TA.) ―
-b3- The quality, in a man, of having the teeth separate, one from another, (S,) [and even in the manner of growth, &c.] ―
-b4- And Coldness, or coolness, of water. (Kr, M, K.) ＝
-A2- See also the next paragraph, in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
